# MyXQL v0.9.0 - Table of Contents

MySQL 5.5+ driver for Elixir

## Pages

- [MyXQL](https://myxql.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [MyXQL](https://myxql.hexdocs.pm/MyXQL.md): MySQL driver for Elixir.

- [MyXQL.GeometryCodec](https://myxql.hexdocs.pm/MyXQL.GeometryCodec.md): Contract for encoding/decoding geometry types.
- [MyXQL.Queries](https://myxql.hexdocs.pm/MyXQL.Queries.md): A struct for a prepared statement that returns multiple results.
- [MyXQL.Query](https://myxql.hexdocs.pm/MyXQL.Query.md): A struct for a prepared statement that returns a single result.
- [MyXQL.Result](https://myxql.hexdocs.pm/MyXQL.Result.md): Result struct returned from any successful query.

- Exceptions
  - [MyXQL.Error](https://myxql.hexdocs.pm/MyXQL.Error.md)
